extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and toolbar.

extDescription.message: Connects the Kaiord editor to your WHOOP recovery & sleep data through your open WHOOP session — no developer app, no passwords.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store.

checking.description: Status verdict while the popup probes the session.

checkingCause.description: Status cause sentence shown while the probe runs.

connected.description: Status verdict when a WHOOP session bearer has been captured.

connectedCause.message: Reading your WHOOP data through your open session.
connectedCause.description: Status cause sentence for the connected state.

connectedCauseAgo.message: Reading your WHOOP data through your open session. Captured $phrase$.
connectedCauseAgo.description: Status cause sentence for the connected state, naming when the session token was captured.

sessionSignedOut.description: Status verdict when no WHOOP session bearer is available.

sessionSignedOutCause.message: Your WHOOP tab is signed out, so nothing is reaching Kaiord right now.
sessionSignedOutCause.description: Status cause sentence naming the consequence of a signed-out session.

captionMissing.description: Caption above the paused-capability chips in the signed-out state.

typeSleep.description: Capability chip for the Sleep data type imported into Kaiord.

typeHrv.description: Capability chip for the HRV data type imported into Kaiord.

typeStrain.description: Capability chip for the Strain data type imported into Kaiord.

typeVitals.description: Capability chip for the Vitals data type imported into Kaiord.

typeStress.description: Capability chip for the Stress data type imported into Kaiord.

typeHeartRateSeries.description: Capability chip for the Heart Rate Series data type imported into Kaiord.

typeActivity.description: Capability chip for the Activity data type imported into Kaiord.

moreTypes.description: Chip collapsing the data types that do not fit the popup width.

openEditor.description: Footer link that opens the Kaiord editor.

signInWhoop.description: Primary footer link that fixes a signed-out WHOOP session.

openWhoop.description: Secondary footer link opening app.whoop.com in a new tab.

refresh.description: Accessible label for the header refresh button.
